senses.gloss:
नुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, commended.
 E. णु to praise, aff. क्त.

नुत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Sent, ordered, despatched.
 m. (-त्तः) A plant:
see लकुच.
 E. णुद to send, aff. क्त; also नुन्न.

नूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. New.
 2. Praised, eulogized, hymned.
 E. णु
to praise, aff. क्त.

नुति f. (-निः)
 1. Praise, eulogium, panegyric.
 2. Worship, reverence.
E. णु to praise, क्तिन् aff.

नूतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
 1. New, recent, fresh, young, &c.
 2. Present.
3. Instantaneous.
 4. Modern.
 5. Curious.
 E. नव new, नू substituted
for it, and तनप् aff. नुरादेशश्च ।

नूततत्व n. (-त्वं) Newness, novelty.
 E. त्व added to the last; also with
तल्, नूतनता.

नूत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) New.
 E. नू substituted for नव new, त्नप् aff.
